name: kb_180_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: SecretReference represents a Secret Reference. It has enough information to retrieve secret in any namespace

name.description: Name is unique within a namespace to reference a secret resource.

namespace.description: Namespace defines the space within which the secret name must be unique.

schema.description: Represents storage that is managed by an external CSI volume driver (Beta feature)

controllerExpandSecretRef.description: ControllerExpandSecretRef is a reference to the secret object containing sensitive information to pass to the CSI driver to complete the CSI ControllerExpandVolume call. This is an alpha field and requires enabling ExpandCSIVolumes feature gate. This field is optional, and may be empty if no secret is required. If the secret object contains more than one secret, all secrets are passed.

controllerPublishSecretRef.description: ControllerPublishSecretRef is a reference to the secret object containing sensitive information to pass to the CSI driver to complete the CSI ControllerPublishVolume and ControllerUnpublishVolume calls. This field is optional, and may be empty if no secret is required. If the secret object contains more than one secret, all secrets are passed.

driver.description: Driver is the name of the driver to use for this volume. Required.

fsType.description: Filesystem type to mount. Must be a filesystem type supported by the host operating system. Ex. "ext4", "xfs", "ntfs".

nodePublishSecretRef.description: NodePublishSecretRef is a reference to the secret object containing sensitive information to pass to the CSI driver to complete the CSI NodePublishVolume and NodeUnpublishVolume calls. This field is optional, and may be empty if no secret is required. If the secret object contains more than one secret, all secrets are passed.

nodeStageSecretRef.description: NodeStageSecretRef is a reference to the secret object containing sensitive information to pass to the CSI driver to complete the CSI NodeStageVolume and NodeStageVolume and NodeUnstageVolume calls. This field is optional, and may be empty if no secret is required. If the secret object contains more than one secret, all secrets are passed.

readOnly.description: Optional: The value to pass to ControllerPublishVolumeRequest. Defaults to false (read/write).

volumeAttributes.description: Attributes of the volume to publish.

volumeHandle.description: VolumeHandle is the unique volume name returned by the CSI volume plugin’s CreateVolume to refer to the volume on all subsequent calls. Required.

description:
The CSI volume to be used is provided by the driver **csi.example.com**, and it is identified internally by the handle **vol-1234567890abcdef**. The filesystem type for mounting is **ext4**, and the volume is configured for read/write access (the read‑only flag is set to false).

For the various CSI calls the following Kubernetes Secret references have been defined, all residing in the **storage-system** namespace: the controller expansion secret is **csi-expand-secret**, the controller publish secret is **csi-publish-secret**, the node publish secret is **csi-node-publish-secret**, and the node stage secret is **csi-node-stage-secret**. The volume also carries two attributes: a provisioner identity of **12345-abcde** (key `storage.kubernetes.io/csiProvisionerIdentity`) and an encryption flag set to **true**.
